title: Affine response-space damping bridge for frozen G11 head-space P4 contraction

supporting_run.note: The supporting postimage executed the same G19 block twice because two parallel runner edits duplicated it. The deduplicated final postimage is the authority.

frozen_bridge.rule: At h0 keep slope p fixed and set q_ref(lambda)=G(h0)+lambda*(q_swap(h0)-G(h0)); solve the resulting affine response from the same accepted groundwater origin.

bounded_conclusions: For the frozen G11 groundwater stress, the measured groundwater response is affine to approximately 3.71e-21 m/s maximum fit error.
With the physical SWAP tangent held fixed, interpolation of only the affine response intercept maps algebraically to the same head interpolation as head-space damping.
The live MODFLOW fresh-solve route reproduces the full raw Newton head at lambda=1, the first half-step at lambda=1/2, and the second half-step at lambda=1/4 to floating-point head precision.
The real SWAP participant reproduces the exact G11 acceptance topology: lambda=1 and lambda=1/2 are participant status 6, while lambda=1/4 is status 0 and passes the unchanged merit rule.
This provides a concrete bridge around the G18 direct state-control gap without setting or restoring MODFLOW X.

The result is bounded to fresh solves from the same accepted groundwater origin and an affine groundwater response. It is not yet evidence that the same response-damping sequence works inside one continuous F-GC38 prepared solve.
No production coupling policy or HCOF/RHS semantics are changed.
next_natural_unit: Qualify the same lambda=1 -> 1/2 -> 1/4 response sequence inside one continuous live F-GC38 prepared solve with fixed XOLD and evolving X, comparing each converged response state to the G19 fresh-origin references and preserving SWAP diagnostic non-authority.
